topic: Turn one idea into 10 posts with one AI prompt

hook.text: Turn 1 idea into 10 posts in 3 steps

scenes.vo: Step one. Open ChatGPT or Claude and paste this prompt. Both have free plans.
scenes.prompt: Turn my idea [your idea] into 10 Instagram post ideas for [your audience]. Give each one a hook, 3 key points and a call to action. Keep it simple.

scenes.vo: Step two. Swap in your idea and your audience. Hit enter.
You get 10 angles like myths, tips, mistakes and checklists, each with a hook and key points.
scenes.title: 1 idea, 10 angles

scenes.vo: Step three. Pick your best 5, rewrite them in your own voice, then schedule them for the week.
scenes.title: edit before posting

scenes.vo: Check every fact before posting. Then post one today. Save this for your next idea.
scenes.title: Your next move

caption:
One idea can fill your whole week.

Use this ChatGPT prompt to turn one idea into 10 posts for your AI side hustle.

Bonus tip: ask for the same idea as a Reel script, a carousel and a story.

Send this to the friend who says they never know what to post.
